chapter.verse: Tua hi a, upna hangin diksakna a ngah i hih nungsang i Topa Jesu Khris tungtawnin Pasian tawh a kinuam a kilem i hi hi.
Ama' tungtawnin tu-a i dinna mun ahi hehpihna sungah upna tawh a lut thei i hi a, Pasian' minpha i lametna hangin kipakin i om hi.
Tua bek hilo-in i gentheihnate ah zong i kipak hi. A hang pen gentheihna in thuakzawhna,
thuakzawhna in picing gamtatna, picing gamtatna in lametna piangsak, cih i thei hi.
Tua lametna in ei hong maizumsak ngeilo hi. A hang pen ei' tunga hong kipiasa Kha Siangtho tungtawnin i lungtang sungah Pasian' itna hong kisung khin ahih man hi.
A hang pen eite cimawhin i om laitak a kilawm hunin kihtakbei misiate' ading Khris hong si hi.
Mihoih khat' taangin a si ngam a omkha phial zongin midik khat' taangin a si ding mi kikhaat hi.
Himah taleh eite mimawh i hih laitak eite' taangin Khris hong sihna tawh Pasian in ama' hong itna hong lakkhia hi.
Tua hi a, tu-in eite pen ama' sisan hangin diksakna ngah khin i hih nungsang Pasian' hehna pan hong kihonkhia kan lai ding hi.

A hang pen eite gal i hih laitak ama' Tapa' sihna tungtawnin Pasian' kiangah hong kilemtuah khin ahihleh tu-in leptuahte i hih nungsang ama' nuntakna hangin eite hong kihonkhia kan ding hilo ahi hiam?
Bek thamlo, eite' kilemkikna ahi i Topa Jesu Khris tungtawnin Pasian' sungah eite kipakin i om hi.
Tua hi a, mi khat tungtawnin leitung ah mawhna hong lutin tua mawhna tungtawnin sihna hong lut ahi hi. Tua dan mahin mi khempeuh mawh ahih manin vekpi' tungah sihna hong kizel hi.
A hang pen thukhun a om ma-in leitung ah mawhna om khin a, ahi zongin thukhun a omlohna mun ah mawhna zong thu-in kisim lo hi.
Himah taleh Adam' hun pan Moses' hun dongin sihna in mite uk a, a hong pai ding mipa etsakna lim ahi Adam' palsatna tawh a kibanglo, mawhna dang a bawlte nangawn uk hi.

Ahih hangin tatkhialhna leh hehpihna gah kibang lo hi. A hang pen mi khat' tatkhialhna hangin mi tampi si ahihleh Pasian' hehpihna leh Jesu Khris a kici mi khat ii hehpihna hanga kingah deihguat thupha pen mi tampi' ading kicingzaw kan lai hi.

Khuttawi cih ciangin mi khat ii bawl mawhna gah tawh kibang lo hi. A hang pen tatkhialhna khat khit ah thukhenna hong pai a, tua in gawtna hong tun ahih hangin tatkhialhna tampi khit-a a hong pai hehpihna gah in diksakna hong tun hi.

Mi khat a tatkhialh manin tua mi khat' tungtawnin sihna in ukna nei ahihleh hehpihna a tampi leh deihguat thupha diksakna a ngah mite in mi khat mah ahi Jesu Khris' tungtawnin nuntakna sungah ukna neizaw kan ding uh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua hi a, tatkhialhna khat in mi khempeuh gawtna tuaksak ahih mah bangin diktatna khat in mi khempeuh' adingin nuntakna tawh kipawl diksakna thu tungsak hi.
A hang pen mi khat' thumanlohna hangin a tampite mimawh a kisuahsak mah bangin mi khat' thumanna hangin a tampite midik kisuaksak ding hi.
Tu-in thukhun pen tatkhialhna a khangsak dingin hong pai a, ahi zongin mawhna a khanna mun ah hehpihna khangzaw sem lai hi.
Tua pen sihna thu ah mawhna a thunei ahih mah bangin Jesu Khris i Topa hangin tawntung nuntakna hong tunpih ding ahi diksakna thu ah hehpihna a thunei ahih nading ahi hi.
